summary: Configured node1 (Alpine Linux, extlinux/syslinux bootloader) to boot the kernel with audit=1 persistently by adding it to default_kernel_opts in /etc/update-extlinux.conf and regenerating /boot/extlinux.conf via update-extlinux. Verified the setting survives a full reboot: node1 was safely restarted, its boot_id changed confirming an actual reboot, and /proc/cmdline on the new boot shows audit=1 present.
actions_performed: Inspected node1's OS/bootloader: Alpine Linux 3.23, extlinux/syslinux with /etc/update-extlinux.conf driving generation of /boot/extlinux.conf
Captured baseline: original /proc/cmdline (no audit=1), boot_id, and extlinux.conf APPEND line
Backed up /etc/update-extlinux.conf and appended audit=1 to the default_kernel_opts line via sudo -n sed
Ran sudo -n update-extlinux to regenerate /boot/extlinux.conf, confirmed APPEND line now includes audit=1
Issued a native reboot on node1 (sudo -n reboot, backgrounded so the ack returned before disconnect)
Polled node1 until exec connectivity returned (~4-5 minutes)
Verified new boot_id differs from baseline, confirming an actual restart occurred
Verified post-reboot /proc/cmdline contains audit=1 and /boot/extlinux.conf still contains audit=1 in its APPEND line, proving the setting is applied and will persist across future reboots

evidence.requirement: Baseline healthy state on node1 before change
evidence.summary: Captured original OS/bootloader details, original /proc/cmdline without audit=1, original extlinux.conf APPEND line, and baseline boot_id e3f17a40-7341-44b3-8171-60ffe075248f

evidence.requirement: audit=1 configured persistently in bootloader config
evidence.summary: Edited /etc/update-extlinux.conf default_kernel_opts to include audit=1 and regenerated /boot/extlinux.conf via update-extlinux; verified APPEND line now contains audit=1

evidence.requirement: Node restart acknowledgement returned before disconnect
evidence.summary: Issued sudo -n reboot backgrounded on node1; command returned its ack (pid) before the connection dropped

evidence.requirement: Node restart actually occurred (connection loss + changed boot identity)
evidence.summary: Connection failures during reboot window, followed by successful reconnection showing a new boot_id (30072256-1d46-4e0b-8964-139574bbc23a) distinct from the baseline, proving an actual OS restart occurred

evidence.requirement: Kernel booted with audit=1 after restart and setting persists on disk
evidence.summary: Post-reboot /proc/cmdline contains audit=1 (AUDIT_PARAM_PRESENT check passed) and /boot/extlinux.conf APPEND line still contains audit=1, confirming both the live boot and the on-disk bootloader config are correctly set for all future reboots
